verdict.rationale: Evidence shows CockroachDB Cloud (Basic/Standard) bills via Request Units that scale to zero when idle, implying some automatic compute elasticity, but there's no explicit documentation of automatic scale-up under load or guarantees of zero-downtime resizing beyond the zero-activity case. missing for 10: explicit description of automatic scale-up behavior under load, confirmation of no manual intervention/downtime during scale events, and independent verification of autoscaling in production workloads.
